entries.name: Strong Root
entries.description: Ability Activation ID: 117 - Refresh Time: 1:12:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. This ability, when activated, roots your target in place for up to 48 seconds with a 300 point resist modifier and a 2 second cast time. Requirements: level 35.

entries.name: Unbound Destruction
entries.description: This passive ability increases your chance to land a critical hit with your direct damage spells by 2/4/6%. Requirements: level 12.
